name: Token Movement
description: Moving the piece around the track. Advances a token along world.board_track_path's edges by whatever a roll or card granted, counts laps as it passes the start space, and resolves captures when one token lands on another. It owns positions, lap counts, and capture resolution — and nothing about how far to move: the number arrives via utility.diceRolled or a card effect, and this component treats both identically, because a mover that cares where its move came from is a rules engine wearing a mover's clothes. Route choice at a branch is answered through input.chooseBranch after world.board_track_path asks; this component executes the choice, it does not make it. It also declines to decide what laps mean — lapsToWin defaults to zero because the win rule belongs to the game mode, not the mover.

inputs.name: tokensPerPlayer
inputs.description: Pieces each player controls. Above one, captures and blocks become positional play instead of coincidence.

inputs.name: captureRule
inputs.description: sendToStart | swap | coexist — what happens when a landing space is occupied. coexist disables captures entirely, which is the right call for race-to-the-finish designs.

inputs.name: lapsToWin
inputs.description: 0 means laps are tracked and emitted but not a verdict. The win condition belongs to the game mode; this component only promises the count is right.

outputs.name: tokenPositions
outputs.description: Space id per token id — the whole board state in one read.

outputs.name: lapsCompleted
outputs.description: Lap count per player, for pass-start payouts and finish detection.
